note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative (jurisdiction unspecified). Lane A and lane B (the supplied conducts of A and of B, the affected person) are drawn at equal size and weight; the convergence piece only shows the supplied description. No fault, share, percentage, contributory-negligence doctrine, liability, amount or outcome is stated. Long-labels-stress: coordinator decision (standing stress-cap rule, docs/AUTHORING.md item 20; subject >= 0.20 of the frame height as in accepted LAW-0700/0710). True driver: the 1:1 box (lane piece + plinth >= 0.20 of the frame height). Fallbacks tried: row, rowcol, stack and band compositions; the convergence chip moved off the record; the loss moved to the band. Rendered at 1080p (2026-10-05; pre-cap copy production/scratch/causation-09/LAW-0714.stress-precap.json): four steps, one account, two loss items, a labelled connector → 1:1 subject 0.165; one loss item, no connector label → 0.182; also no account → 0.215. Capped to four steps, no account, one loss item and no connector label (baseline 2 / 0 / 1 / 0); every text field keeps a near-maximum length strictly longer than the baseline.
